title.zh: 服务上线与可靠性演练

brief.zh: 发布负责人发现候选版本错误增多。结合每版请求分母、核心业务探测与发布后新增记录，决定何时停止、能否回退，以及是否真的恢复。
brief.en: A release owner must decide whether a rollback restored the service. Reconcile technical probes, the critical business flow and records written after release.

zh: 证据定位、验证结果和复盘行动
en: a release/rollback log and recovery decision

zh: 服务探测和固定指标可复算
恢复前后版本与操作记录一致
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
A normal error rate with a failed business probe is not recovery. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 旧库/旧版本缺少发布后新增数据时不能直接回退
failure.en: A normal error rate with a failed business probe is not recovery.

en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 发布负责人发现候选版本错误增多。结合每版请求分母、核心业务探测与发布后新增记录，决定何时停止、能否回退，以及是否真的恢复。
旧库/旧版本缺少发布后新增数据时不能直接回退；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A release owner must decide whether a rollback restored the service.
Reproduce this failure first: A normal error rate with a failed business probe is not recovery.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
